# prikk_store - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/crate/prikk-store/0.3.0/target-redirect/prikk_store/

## Expand description

Storage crate for Prikk repositories.

This crate provides persistent layout, object storage, WAL durability, deeper read-only repository verification, initial ref-state/ref-log publication primitives, a narrow active-session append API, opt-in safe doctor repairs, conservative snapshot materialization, read-only worktree status, minimal worktree-to-patch draft generation, supported patch replay planning and materialization, explicit opt-in deletion of patch-removed files, conservative full-file text edit replay, opt-in full-file text edit generation from worktree changes, and read-only inverse planning for the supported patch subset, non-mutating rollback preview, conservative rollback draft append to an empty active WAL, rollback draft verification, and sealed rollback block classification. Full patch algebra, plugin execution, and remote sync remain separate increments.

## Structs[§](https://docs.rs#structs)

- [Active](https://docs.rs/struct.ActiveCommitResult.html)- Commit - Result
- Result of appending a patch envelope to the active session.

- Active session lock acquired before mutating an active WAL tail.

- Default active-session handle.

## Functions[§](https://docs.rs#functions)

- [append_](https://docs.rs/fn.append_rollback_draft.html)- rollback_ - draft
- Append a signed inverse Patch draft to an empty active WAL.
- [author_](https://docs.rs/fn.author_signature.html)- signature
- Build a role-bound AUTHOR `Signature``object_id`using`signer`.
- [commit_](https://docs.rs/fn.commit_worktree_changes_signed.html)- worktree_ - changes_ - signed
- Author a node-addressed patch from worktree changes against the replay-derived baseline, sign it
with a real role-bound Ed25519 AUTHOR signature from the injected `signer`, and append it to the active WAL (DC-09 Phase 4.4a, R1). Existing paths resolve to their persisted`node_id`; fresh nodes are minted through the production [`NodeIdGenerator`]; text edits go through the shared`text_span`module. There is no placeholder signing path.
- [doctor_](https://docs.rs/fn.doctor_repository.html)- repository
- Run doctor diagnostics for a repository layout.
- [load_](https://docs.rs/fn.load_ref_history.html)- ref_ - history
- Load history for a ref, newest first.
- [materialize_](https://docs.rs/fn.materialize_patch_checkout.html)- patch_ - checkout
- Materialize the supported patch replay result into the repository worktree.
- [materialize_](https://docs.rs/fn.materialize_patch_checkout_with_deletions.html)- patch_ - checkout_ - with_ - deletions
- Materialize the supported patch replay result and remove explicit patch-deleted files.
- [materialize_](https://docs.rs/fn.materialize_snapshot_checkout.html)- snapshot_ - checkout
- Materialize a snapshot-backed checkout into the repository worktree.
- [plan_](https://docs.rs/fn.plan_patch_checkout_deletions.html)- patch_ - checkout_ - deletions
- Prepare a read-only deletion plan for explicit patch-deleted files.
- [prepare_](https://docs.rs/fn.prepare_checkout_plan.html)- checkout_ - plan
- Prepare a checkout plan for a ref without modifying the worktree.
- [prepare_](https://docs.rs/fn.prepare_patch_inverse_plan.html)- patch_ - inverse_ - plan
- Prepare an unsigned inverse Patch payload for the supported patch-operation subset.
- [prepare_](https://docs.rs/fn.prepare_patch_replay_plan.html)- patch_ - replay_ - plan
- Replay the supported operation subset for a ref without writing the worktree.
- [prepare_](https://docs.rs/fn.prepare_rollback_preview.html)- rollback_ - preview
- Prepare a non-mutating rollback preview for the supported patch-operation subset.
- [prepare_](https://docs.rs/fn.prepare_snapshot_checkout_plan.html)- snapshot_ - checkout_ - plan
- Prepare and validate a snapshot-backed checkout plan without writing the worktree.
- [repair_](https://docs.rs/fn.repair_repository.html)- repository
- Run an explicitly requested, narrow repair action.
- [validate_](https://docs.rs/fn.validate_no_path_collisions.html)- no_ - path_ - collisions
- Reject duplicate paths and case-insensitive collisions.
- [validate_](https://docs.rs/fn.validate_repo_path.html)- repo_ - path
- Validate that a path is safe for v1 worktree materialization.
- [verify_](https://docs.rs/fn.verify_active_rollback_draft.html)- active_ - rollback_ - draft
- Verify that the active WAL contains exactly one rollback draft matching the current ref.
- [verify_](https://docs.rs/fn.verify_repository.html)- repository
- Verify a repository layout without modifying it.
- [worktree_](https://docs.rs/fn.worktree_status.html)- status
- Compute read-only worktree status against the snapshot referenced by a ref.

# prikk_store - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/prikk-store/0.3.0/prikk_store/index.html

## Expand description

Storage crate for Prikk repositories.

This crate provides persistent layout, object storage, WAL durability, deeper read-only repository verification, initial ref-state/ref-log publication primitives, a narrow active-session append API, opt-in safe doctor repairs, conservative snapshot materialization, read-only worktree status, minimal worktree-to-patch draft generation, supported patch replay planning and materialization, explicit opt-in deletion of patch-removed files, conservative full-file text edit replay, opt-in full-file text edit generation from worktree changes, and read-only inverse planning for the supported patch subset, non-mutating rollback preview, conservative rollback draft append to an empty active WAL, rollback draft verification, and sealed rollback block classification. Full patch algebra, plugin execution, and remote sync remain separate increments.

- Validate that a path is safe for v1 worktree materialization.
- [verify_](https://docs.rs/fn.verify_active_rollback_draft.html)- active_ - rollback_ - draft
- Verify that the active WAL contains exactly one rollback draft matching the current ref.
- [verify_](https://docs.rs/fn.verify_repository.html)- repository
- Verify a repository layout without modifying it.
- [worktree_](https://docs.rs/fn.worktree_status.html)- status
- Compute read-only worktree status against the snapshot referenced by a ref.

---

## Fields[§](https://docs.rs#fields)

`ref_name: `[String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html)Ref used as the inverse planning target.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.target_block_id)

`target_block_id: `[ObjectId](https://docs.rs/prikk-object/0.3.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/prikk_object/id/struct.ObjectId.html)Target block ID whose supported patch chain was inspected.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.block_count)

`block_count: `[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)Number of blocks walked from the root side to the target.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.patch_count)

`patch_count: `[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)Number of patch objects inspected.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.inverse_operation_count)

`inverse_operation_count: `[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)Number of inverse operations generated.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.inverse_patch_id_hint)

`inverse_patch_id_hint: `[ObjectId](https://docs.rs/prikk-object/0.3.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/prikk_object/id/struct.ObjectId.html)Unsigned inverse Patch object ID hint.

This ID is only a deterministic planning hint for the unsigned payload. It is not a published object, and it is not sufficient authorization for rollback.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.inverse_payload)

`inverse_payload: `[PatchPayload](https://docs.rs/prikk-object/0.3.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/prikk_object/payload/patch/struct.PatchPayload.html)Unsigned inverse Patch payload.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.operations)

`operations: `[Vec](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/vec/struct.Vec.html)<[PatchInverseOperationSummary](https://docs.rs/struct.PatchInverseOperationSummary.html)>Human-readable summary of inverse operations in application order.

Reconstruct a missing ref pointer from the latest valid log record.

This method is deliberately narrow: it writes only the pointer file for a ref whose log and target RefState object already verify. It does not synthesize objects or repair malformed logs.

Safely truncate an incomplete trailing WAL record, if one exists.

This repairs only the case that FDD-02 defines as safe: valid records followed by an incomplete final record. Checksum mismatches in complete records still return an error and are not modified.

Result of authoring and appending a node-addressed patch from worktree changes.

## Fields[§](https://docs.rs#fields)

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.ref_name)

`ref_name: `[String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html)Baseline ref used to classify changes.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.patch_id)

`patch_id: `[ObjectId](https://docs.rs/prikk-object/0.3.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/prikk_object/id/struct.ObjectId.html)Patch object ID appended to the active WAL.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.wal_sequence)

`wal_sequence: `[u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html)WAL sequence assigned to the patch envelope.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.operation_count)

`operation_count: `[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)Number of patch operations emitted.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.referenced_blob_count)

`referenced_blob_count: `[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)Number of Blob object references written or reused for operation payloads.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.text_edit_count)

`text_edit_count: `[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)Number of whole-file `EditText` operations emitted (text-file modifications).

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.changes)

`changes: `[Vec](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/vec/struct.Vec.html)<[WorktreePatchOperationSummary](https://docs.rs/struct.WorktreePatchOperationSummary.html)>Operation summaries in emitted order.
